Updated the adapter-consumer observation-loss paragraph for #3560. Traced consumeAdapterEvents -> publishObservedEvent (bounded SQLITE_BUSY retry of the same eventId, hasEventId guard against replaying a committed row) and DeltaCoalescer.retainFailedFlush (text flushed ahead of a retried event is kept and delivered first). The existing claims still hold for non-contention failures and exhausted retries: runtime.warning adapter-event-stream-interrupted, lifecycle unchanged, no replacement dispatch.
